title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 19 JUNE 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 18 June 2026 Several spells of showers will occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Mullaitivu, Ampara and Batticaloa districts after 2.00 p.m. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
